name: Floating Library of Whispering Pages
description: A massive open-air library suspended among clouds, its books fluttering like birds, each page releasing a soft whisper.
prompt: A gigantic library structure floating among fluffy cumulus clouds at sunrise. Bookshelves are open, and the pages of countless books detach and flutter like white birds, glowing faintly. Soft golden light filters through the clouds. Ethereal, dreamy atmosphere, high detail, panoramic perspective.
caption: Stories that fly off the shelf 📚☁️ #FloatingLibrary
